熊狩り 左英雄チェッカー

集結に「乗る側」で意味を持つのは、編成の左端の英雄の第1遠征スキルだけです。あなたが左に置こうとしている英雄が熊に効くのかを判定し、4人分そろえた時の相性まで診断します。

About this tool

Full explanation & FAQ

What this tool tells you

When you join a rally, only the first expedition skill of the hero in the leftmost slot takes effect. Following that rule, this checker tells you whether the heroes you picked actually contribute to a Bear Hunt rally, and whether the four joiner slots overlap in skill type.

How it works

Using the hero master data, each hero's first expedition skill is classified as damage / attack / lethality / proc / no effect on the bear (a single boss). Skills of the same type add up and plateau, so the more varied the four slots are, the higher the rally's damage is rated.

How to use it

Pick your current generation, then tap the heroes the four joiners place in their leftmost slot. The result shows whether each one works, its skill type and swap suggestions; replace any 'no effect' hero with another of the same troop type.

左英雄のルール早わかり

Q. 左端以外の英雄は効きますか?
乗り側では効きません。見られるのは左端の英雄の「第1遠征スキル」のみで、2人目・3人目の英雄や、英雄レベル・装備・星は熊へのダメージに影響しません(兵士はダメージに寄与します)。
Q. 4枠はどう選ばれますか?
集結全体で採用されるバフは、参加者の中から最大4枠です。基本は先着順ですが、後からより高いスキルレベルの同種スキルが来ると上書きされます。Lv5を4人最初に乗せると枠が安定します。
Q. なぜ種類をバラけさせると強いの?
同じ種類のスキルは足し算、違う種類は掛け算で効くためです。与ダメ・攻撃・殺傷・確率系を散らすと、同じスキルレベルでも合計倍率が高くなります。

What is the Left-Hero Checker?

In a Bear Hunt rally, the 1st expedition skill of the rally leader (the hero placed on the far left) applies to everyone in the rally. A joiner's left hero does not always take effect. This unofficial checker instantly tells you whether your left hero is effective when joining, optimizes the 4-slot combination, and lists candidates by generation.

How to use it

  1. Select the hero you plan to lead with, or a candidate from your roster.
  2. It judges whether the 1st expedition skill is "effective / not effective."
  3. It shows 4-slot combinations and per-generation picks — handy to check before you join a rally.

Why the left hero matters

Rally damage mainly comes from the rally leader's expedition skills. On the joining side, whether a hero's effect applies depends on the hero and skill type. Most "I added a strong hero but it didn't help" cases come down to a left-hero selection mistake. This tool automates that judgment so you avoid wasted setups.

Reading the results

  • Effective heroes are worth placing as rally leader.
  • Not effective heroes won't apply on the left — move them to another slot or swap them out.
  • Per-generation candidates help you pick the realistic best from your roster.

FAQ

Shouldn't I just put my strongest hero on the left?
Not necessarily. What matters is whether the 1st expedition skill suits rallying — a high-attack hero may not apply.
Does the joiner formation matter?
Less than the leader, but troop ratio and hero combos still affect damage. Check ratios in the Troop Ratio Simulator.
